html:
FYI Yachts is proud to announce the successful sale of the 2021 Pursuit 428 S “Light Em Up,” another outstanding transaction that reflects the firm’s continued success in the premium sport and offshore boating market.


Jose Noy of FYI Yachts proudly represented the buyer, while Todd Royal of Legendary Marine Group in Destin, Florida, represented the seller, resulting in a smooth and successful transaction for all parties involved.
The Pursuit 428 S is renowned for its exceptional craftsmanship, innovative design, and versatile performance. Combining luxury cruising amenities with serious offshore capability, the 42-foot flagship sport model offers expansive seating, premium accommodations, cutting-edge technology, and the legendary ride quality that has made Pursuit one of the most respected names in boating.


This successful transaction highlights Jose Noy’s commitment to providing personalized service, expert market guidance, and a seamless purchasing experience for his clients throughout every stage of the buying process.
“It was a pleasure helping my client find the right boat and guiding them through every step of the transaction,” said Jose Noy. “The Pursuit 428 S is an exceptional vessel that perfectly blends performance, comfort, and versatility. Congratulations to the new owners, and I wish them many unforgettable adventures on the water.”


FYI Yachts also extends its appreciation to Todd Royal and the Legendary Marine Group for their professionalism and cooperation throughout the transaction. The FYI Yachts team congratulates everyone involved and wishes the new owners countless memorable experiences aboard “Light Em Up”.
